facts.fact: EthioPay, run by EthSwitch, currently supports interoperable person-to-person payments across 51 institutions, ETHQR payments across 40 and Request to Pay across 30, per EthSwitch's marketing director.
EthioPay is an interoperable instant payment platform connecting banks, microfinance institutions, payment instrument issuers and payment system operators.
EthSwitch is described as Ethiopia's national payment switch operator and builds and runs EthioPay.
